w6roles_perm_alerts_help: Acknowledge, ignore and silence alerts, take on-call shifts, add change markers and run remediation actions, as an operator does.
w6roles_perm_maintenance_help: Schedule, edit and remove maintenance windows.
w6roles_perm_monitors_help: Create, edit, import and delete monitors, monitor templates, alert rules and SLOs. Device credentials can be entered, never read back.
w6roles_perm_notifications_help: Edit notification channels, the notification policy and message templates. The email server stays with administrators.
w6roles_perm_reports_help: Read the scheduled reports and download their PDF.
w6roles_perm_status_pages_help: Edit status pages and publish incidents. Page passwords and subscribers stay with administrators.
w6roles_perm_view_help: Read monitors, alerts, metrics and everything else a viewer reads.
w6roles_section_admin_only: Accounts, roles, teams, API tokens, single sign-on, backups and instance settings stay with administrators: no permission opens them.
w6roles_section_delete_error: The role could not be deleted
w6roles_section_description: Give an account chosen rights without making it an admin. A custom role replaces the built-in role of the accounts that have it.
w6roles_section_empty_body: The built-in roles cover most needs. Create one when someone should, for example, edit monitors without touching accounts.
w6roles_section_in_use: Give its accounts another role before deleting it.
w6roles_section_load_error: Custom roles could not be loaded
w6roles_section_search_kw: custom role permissions rights delegate access
w6roles_users_custom_help: A custom role replaces the built-in role: the account gets exactly the permissions of that role.
